description: Apply to DSTI School of Engineering with guided support in ChatGPT. Explore programmes and entry requirements, start or resume an application, review what remains, prepare updates, and submit only after your explicit confirmation. Approved study-abroad agencies can also support applicants they represent. Guidance comes directly from DSTI's application system. Documents, identity checks, payments and restricted personal information remain within the secure DSTI Application Portal.
